title: Vampire Vape Banoffee Pie E-Liquid 10ml
description: The Vampire Vape Banoffee Pie E-Liquid 10ml is Ideal for vapers with a sweet tooth who enjoys the creamy blend of banana and toffee. So, if you’re a vaper with a penchant for sweet flavours you won’t want to miss out on this dreamy desert vape. Each inhale and exhale offers the taste of thick freshly whipped cream. Slathered upon a moreish buttery biscuit base topped with a blanket of freshly sliced Bananas. Quite simply this Vampire Vape Banoffee Pie E-Liquid is the delicious desert flavoured vape indulgence your taste buds deserve! This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please Note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage , sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
